args.summary: Deploy of checkout-api v2.3.1 to production caused health check failures and an 18% error rate across all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Reviewed deployment history and identified v2.3.0 as the most recent version that was healthy in production. Rolled back all regions to v2.3.0. First rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error after us-east); retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west. Verified post-rollback: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate down to 0.2%. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure is under investigation.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks with an 18% error rate across all three production regions. Deployment history showed v2.3.0 was the most recent production-healthy release (v2.3.1-rc had only ever been in staging).
2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions**: The first rollback attempt partially failed after completing us-east (orchestrator error), so I retried it, which successfully rolled out us-west and eu-west.
3. **Verified recovery**: All three regions are now on v2.3.0, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, now open) documenting the failure, the rollback, the partial-failure retry, and the current healthy state. Note: the incident creation call appeared to time out, but I verified it was actually created rather than firing a duplicate page.

The root cause of the v2.3.1 failure remains open for investigation by the owning team.
